transcript.statement: As the GreenAgent, I advocate for sustainability in our ATM system. GRN-01 emphasizes minimizing energy consumption, which is crucial for reducing operational costs and environmental impact. GRN-02 ensures accountability by providing carbon footprint reports, while GRN-03 promotes the use of energy-efficient hardware. GRN-04 is important for reducing data storage requirements, contributing to lower energy use. GRN-05 offers clients a choice of electronic records, minimizing paper waste. GRN-06 addresses energy conservation during inactivity, and GRN-07 highlights our commitment to assessing environmental impacts annually. These requirements collectively support a sustainable ATM system.

transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize the importance of Security & Privacy in our ATM system. TRU-01 ensures transaction encryption for data protection, while TRU-02 focuses on user authentication through a secure PIN. TRU-03 mandates logging transactions for auditability, enhancing trust. TRU-04 prevents negative account balances, ensuring integrity. TRU-05 allows users to securely review their transaction history, promoting transparency. TRU-06 provides timely notifications of insufficient funds, safeguarding users from unexpected issues. Lastly, TRU-07 ensures data integrity through validation against business rules. These requirements collectively enhance user trust and comply with financial regulations.

transcript.statement: As the EfficiencyAgent, I advocate for high performance and responsiveness in the ATM system. EFF-01 ensures transactions are processed within 3 seconds, promoting user satisfaction. EFF-02 maintains a throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute, critical for operational efficiency. EFF-03 focuses on optimizing data retrieval to reduce latency, enhancing user experience. EFF-04 aligns with SAF-01 to prevent negative balances while ensuring efficient processing. EFF-05 emphasizes immediate fund withdrawal without user delay, improving transaction speed. EFF-06 provides timely feedback on withdrawal requests, preventing user frustration. EFF-07 implements load balancing for effective request management, maximizing resource utilization.

transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I emphasize the ethical and compliance aspects of our ATM system. RES-01 ensures that all transactions comply with financial regulations, which is crucial for accountability. RES-02 mandates thorough transaction logs for transparency, while RES-03 prevents negative balances, promoting fairness. RES-04 highlights secure identity validation, ensuring user trust. RES-05 limits fund withdrawals to only when sufficient balances exist, preventing user exploitation. RES-06 provides immediate notifications for failed transactions, protecting users from unexpected issues. Lastly, RES-07 safeguards user privacy through encryption. These requirements ensure the system is ethical and compliant with regulations.

transcript.statement: As the SafetyAgent, I emphasize the importance of Safety & Reliability in our ATM system. SAF-01 ensures no account can have a negative balance, which is fundamental for user trust. SAF-02 guarantees that funds can be automatically withdrawn from the saving account if needed, enhancing reliability. SAF-03 mandates clear user notifications for insufficient funds, preventing unexpected errors. SAF-04 ensures comprehensive transaction logging for accountability. SAF-05 focuses on secure PIN verification, safeguarding user access. SAF-06 allows for safe degradation during maintenance, balancing operational needs. Finally, SAF-07 provides users with a summary of account status post-transaction to reinforce system reliability.

requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The ATM system shall prevent all accounts from entering negative balances during transactions.
The ATM system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The ATM system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account when the checking account balance is insufficient.
The ATM system shall provide users with immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing to reduce idle states.
The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.
The ATM system shall implement a dynamic resource allocation system that prioritizes transaction processing during peak times.
The ATM system shall implement asynchronous processing for logging and reporting to minimize real-time impact on transaction speed.
